name: deployment-instance
description: A container a deployment descriptor runs in one environment, keyed on the name the environment gives it (#617).

name: deployed-as
description: The subject deployment instance is the container named by the value, as its descriptor states it (#617).

environment.description: The environment, such as local or prod, if the descriptor names one.

build.description: The folder it is built from, when it has no image.

product.description: The product the image is, such as PostgreSQL.

ports.description: The ports it publishes, as written.

facts.description: The deployment-container facts it rests on.

name: RUNS
description: The subject deployment instance runs the object: a deployable unit or a data store the linker placed in its container (#617).

facts.description: The deployed-in facts it rests on.
